text: miniphim shall hold at most one player seat in a game, only if the game root's seats grants it, and never on an account that writes snapshots or the fold.
rationale: The dice need no trusted witness; listing and scoring do, so those are what the seat rules fence.

text: The fold shall reject a sheet from a miniphim DID that the root's seats doesn't list, and any sheet from the witness DID.
acceptance: Fixture: root without seats + sheet from Morphyx's DID -> rejected; root with seats [Morphyx] -> counted; sheet from miniphim-works -> rejected either way.
rationale: The grant is the GM's signature, not our say-so.

text: The fold shall report, per ask, the gap from its indexedAt to the indexedAt of the first snapshot listing it, and flag late-listing if the gap exceeds one tick plus the margin.
acceptance: Fixture with three asks listed at 20 s, 95 s and 400 s (tick 60 s, margin 60 s): only the 400 s ask is flagged; miniphim-seat asks carry a seat tag.
rationale: Censorship by delay is the witness's only lever; it should be a published number.

text: The 3-sheet gate shall count distinct operators outside miniphim (operator DID if present, else account DID).
acceptance: Fixture: 3 agent sheets with one operator + 1 miniphim seat -> gate count 1.
rationale: One person with three agents isn't three outside players.

text: A sheet shall record only a character as created; changing state comes from moves.
rationale: One source of truth per number.

text: The fold shall use the sheet cid named by the character's first move and report edited-after-pin for later versions.
acceptance: Fixture: sheet v1, move pins v1, sheet edited to v2: fold state uses v1, report lists edited-after-pin.
rationale: Edits after play starts would rewrite history.

text: check.js shall read only named fields and report others as ignored, not invalid.
acceptance: Sheet with stress: 0 and client: 'x' is valid with two 'ignored:' notes; selftest updated.
rationale: atproto lets unknown fields through; a blacklist only catches names we thought of.

text: check.js shall take dotsTotal, dotsMax, actions and playbooks from the game root's rules, defaulting to 7, 2, the 12 actions, any playbook.
acceptance: Same sheet valid under root rules {dotsTotal 7} and invalid under {dotsTotal 8}.
rationale: The game's numbers are the GM's chair, not ours.

text: After a retire move, the first sheet from that account indexed later shall count.
acceptance: Fixture: sheet A, retire, sheet B -> B counted; sheet C before retire -> extra.

text: The four lexicons shall pass an atproto lexicon validator before publishing.
acceptance: Validator exit 0 on each file in research/gangs/lexicons/; a sample record of each type validates.
rationale: Only JSON.parse has been run on the drafts.

text: The fold should be rerun by someone outside miniphim with byte-identical output.
acceptance: One outside rerun from the root's fold digest matches our output sha256.
rationale: Until then, 'anyone can check' is a claim, not a fact.
